headline: Workday Agrees to Acquire AI Semantic Layer Developer Honeydew
summary: Enterprise cloud software provider Workday announced an agreement to acquire Honeydew, a startup specialising in semantic data layers, to streamline AI agents and analytics tools.
why: Workday provides financial and human capital management software globally. Integrating semantic layers aims to improve the accuracy of generative AI queries across corporate databases.

impacts.name: Workday
impacts.why: Workday agreed to acquire Honeydew to enhance its AI data platform architecture.
